svg.text: Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow a policy from a reviewed pull request to staff attestation.
Policies are Markdown in GitHub; the policy owner reviews and approves each pull request.
A merge to main starts CodePipeline through the GitHub connection.
CodeBuild checks owner, version, and review date, links, and banned terms, then renders the PDF.
The policy is published to a versioned S3 policy library.
A new version event in EventBridge starts the reminder Lambda.
SES emails staff the new policy with a link to read and attest.
Staff attest through the attestation API, and the handler records it in DynamoDB.
Scheduler runs annual reviews and overdue checks; the reminder reads attestations to find who is missing.
CloudTrail logs API activity, KMS encrypts the library, and CloudWatch alarms on pipeline failures.
